international.title: Closer EU ties will give UK say on Brussels decisions, says Ed Miliband
international.summary: Foreign secretary says there is clear case to integrate more closely but does not say if he backs talks on possibly rejoining UK politics live – latest updates Closer links with the EU will mean the UK having a say on decisions made by Brussels, Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary, has argued as ministers faced pressure to move further after Friday’s landmark deal with the EU. Any timetable for closer integration, including possible talks about the UK rejoining the EU, remains unclear after the Brussels summit, with Andy Burnham saying he would now “brainstorm” over future ties.
